title: Puzzle 3d Marquee Preview Perf
description: Add live highlight preview while dragging rectangle/lasso marquee and eliminate post-release freeze by caching projected footprints once per gesture and deferring host shell rebuild.
summary: Fixed remaining group-selection startup delay. Root cause after bbox warm-up: projectObjectGroupToScreenPoints sampled up to 256 vertices per object (with Vector3 clones) before drawing the overlay — O(objects × vertices) on first capture. Changes: fast AABB 8-corner footprint with reused scratch vectors; marqueeViewKey + prefetch cache (pointerdown rAF, idle on register/three-env); capture uses prefetch; removed deferred rAF activation now that capture is cheap; allocation-free projectWorldToClientMarquee. 192 tests pass.
